$comment: Old/new configuration pairs for the Braintrust validation experiment. Model identifiers are placeholders: fill them in at run time with two models whose prices differ materially. Not ANVILMARK product code.

scenarios.name: Model swap on a classification call site
scenarios.qualityMethod: deterministic exact-label match against ground truth

expectedDirection.note: A cheaper model should reduce cost. Whether quality falls is the empirical question. If quality is unchanged, that is itself the finding a real customer would want.

scenarios.name: Prompt expansion on a summarization call site
scenarios.qualityMethod: LLM judge, pairwise, order randomized — no deterministic signal exists for this task

old.label: short-prompt
old.systemPrompt: Summarize the incident report in three sentences.

new.label: long-prompt-with-examples
new.note: Long stable prefix with four few-shot examples. Interacts with prompt caching: cache reads are priced well below standard input, cache writes often above it. A naive token count gets this wrong in both directions.

expectedDirection.cost: unclear — depends entirely on cache behaviour
expectedDirection.note: This scenario exists because the answer is not obvious. If a tool reports a confident cost delta here without modelling cache reads and writes separately, that is a finding.
